prayerExcerpt.en-US: Him who is truly God I worship in mind and in prayer.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Aquele que é verdadeiramente Deus, eu o venero com a mente e com a oração.

meta.face: A man of about forty-five with a compact, square face and a low forehead — a nose with a flattened bridge and a broad tip; narrow, wide-set dark eyes under straight, low brows; wide, flat cheekbones; a strong, wide jaw with a dimpled chin; a thin, firm mouth; close-cropped iron-grey hair, a short, square-trimmed black beard streaked with grey, and a calm, resolute gaze. Clearly older and heavier-built than George and Martin.
meta.basis: Before the 14th century Chrysogonus was shown as a high-ranking Roman officer in cloak and cuirass (christianiconography.info), later as a knight (Giambono, San Trovaso, c. 1444); no source gives his features, so the age and grey are chosen to keep him apart from the young soldier saints.
meta.excerpt: Roman Breviary (pre-1960), lesson for St. Chrysogonus, 24 November: 'Ego eum, qui vere est Deus, mente et oratione veneror' (his answer to Diocletian), translated; Divinum Officium horas/Latin/Sancti/11-24o.txt
